name: Iron (Smelted Ingots Detail)
description: Industrial 3D showcase of smelted samurai iron ingots. Heavy trapezoidal charcoal-black iron bars stacked on a dark anvil, glowing with fiery crimson and orange internal forge heat along the weld seams with floating embers against pitch-black.
prompt: Masterwork 3D detailed concept art of smelted Japanese iron ingots. Stacked heavy charcoal-black iron metal bars resting on a dark blacksmith anvil, glowing with deep fiery crimson red (#FF2035) and molten orange heat along the seams, subtle anvil hammer texture and floating red sparks. Pure pitch-black background (#000000), dramatic high-contrast crimson lighting, 8k render, no text.
